prompt: As of 2024, what is the street address of the headquarters of the American online video sharing platform that was launched in the same year as the founding of the Vancouver Cherry Blossom festival?
answer: The headquarters is at **901 Cherry Avenue, San Bruno, California 94066, United States**. This is the headquarters of **YouTube**, launched in 2005, the same year the Vancouver Cherry Blossom Festival was founded.
